role: research_only; no training; V9/V10 already observed diagnostic, not independent test

rules.point: V5 precision >= 0.9, max coverage, min 30 accepted
rules.wilson: V5 Wilson95 lower bound >= 0.9, max coverage (repo rule)

abstention.confidence: max over summed family probabilities (T = checkpoint temperature)

sourceCV.note: Out-of-fold logits of the 24 saved CV runs (temperature 1.0, not calibrated). Folds differ from the refit checkpoint (trained without the held-out source). V6 has only 4 classes; family F1 averages families with support. Same models were used to select B0/B1, so scores are selection-biased.

limitations: V9/V10 were observed before this analysis; family scope is a post-hoc re-reading of the same data.
Source IDs are not verified independent athletes; clip bootstrap CIs assume i.i.d. clips and are optimistic.
Clips are pre-trimmed positives: no continuous-video detection, no no-punch/other class, so family scope does not measure false events.
The 3-class model was NOT trained; family probabilities are sums of 6-class softmax outputs.
Calibration V5 is a single source; abstention thresholds picked there may not transfer.
